cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/stress_gen.py <<'PY'
import json,random
random.seed(42)
ops=[]
# 4000 front64 groups x2 = 8000
used64=set()
for k in range(4000):
    hi=random.getrandbits(64)
    while hi in used64: hi=random.getrandbits(64)
    used64.add(hi)
    for j in range(2):
        l=random.randint(65,128)
        lo=random.getrandbits(64)
        a=(hi<<64)|lo
        p=(a>>(128-l))<<(128-l)
        if j==1: p |= (1<<(128-l)) if l<128 else 0
        ops.append(['put',f'{p:032x}',l,random.randrange(4194303)])
# 100 front16 groups
used16=set()
while len(used16)<100:
    l=random.randint(17,64)
    a=random.getrandbits(128)
    p=(a>>(128-l))<<(128-l)
    if p>>112 in used16: continue
    used16.add(p>>112)
    ops.append(['put',f'{p:032x}',l,random.randrange(4194303)])
# 92 root0
for i in range(92):
    l=random.randint(0,16)
    a=random.getrandbits(128)
    p=0 if l==0 else (a>>(128-l))<<(128-l)
    ops.append(['put',f'{p:032x}',l,i])
puts=len(ops)
# 3 saves and query chunks
for s in range(3):
    ops.append(['save'])
    if s==0: ops.append(['load_saved',0])
    ops.append(['query',[f'{random.getrandbits(128):032x}' for _ in range(43000)]])
# 3 loads saved for validation benchmark
ops.extend([['load_saved',1],['load_saved',2],['load_saved',0]])
req={'cases':[{'ops':ops}]}
open('/tmp/stress_req.json','w').write(json.dumps(req))
print('puts',puts,'ops',len(ops),'bytes',len(json.dumps(req)))
PY
